topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I was so excited all week, thinking about the big surprise party my friends were planning. The hints, the whispered conversations, the way they looked when I mentioned it—everything seemed to confirm it. But today, I got a text from my best friend. It was short, just saying things have come up, and the get-together isn’t happening. I re-read the message a few times, hoping it was a joke. But it’s clear. I guess life gets in the way, and plans fall through. I’m trying to take it in stride, but it’s hard not to feel let down. I’ll find another time to celebrate, I suppose.
